title: ERA5 preprocessing to analysis-ready daily fields
raw_data_policy: Raw ERA5 NetCDF files are never modified.
temporal_resolution: daily 00 UTC fields, not daily means
important_limitations: ERA5 files are daily 00 UTC snapshots, not daily means.
The validated regional domain is suitable for Bangladesh/South Asia/Eurasian regional composite analysis.
The dataset is not sufficient for full hemispheric NAM, polar-vortex, or zonal-mean diagnostics.
Because only November-February is downloaded, some -45 to +10 event windows may be partly unavailable for early-December or late-February events.
